theme_strategy: Hybrid Light/Dark Public Safety Command aesthetic (Light theme default for ultimate civic trust and legibility, with high-contrast slate dark panels for command status and night road safety)

typography.font_family_body: Plus Jakarta Sans, IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif
typography.font_family_arabic_body: Readex Pro, Noto Sans Arabic, sans-serif

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none
scale.caption: text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-500
scale.arabic_multiplier: Increase font size by 1px and line-height by 1.25 for Arabic text to prevent diacritic clipping

primary_civic_navy.usage: Headers, primary command bars, footer, structural authority frames

signal_amber_accent.usage: Traffic warning indicators, interactive focus elements, active badges, call to action highlights

emergency_signal_red.usage: High-priority alert banner, urgent road closure notices, emergency hotline CTAs

safety_emerald.usage: Quiz success scores, open road status badges, campaign approved seals

contrast_rules.hover_rule: Always explicitly define hover text colors (e.g. hover:bg-amber-600 hover:text-white)

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Dynamic 1px animated highlight on urgent notice banners and quiz active cards
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used on sticky civic header with backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/90 and 1px border-slate-200/50
visual_enhancers.tactical_grid_borders: 1px crisp border lines (border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800) for resource modules and statistics grids
visual_enhancers.subtle_grain: Background noise SVG filter for hero section to give tactile public-sector document weight
visual_enhancers.arabic_rtl_support: Full RTL mirror support via dir='rtl' attribute, custom Tailwind flex-row-reverse, space-x-reverse, and text-right overrides

hero_background.description: Traffic controller directing cars on city street
hero_background.usage: Hero section background with dark gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-950/90 via-slate-900/80 to-slate-900/40)

highway_patrol.description: Traffic police officer sitting on a motorcycle
highway_patrol.usage: Safety Programs card image / Department Initiative showcase

city_traffic_night.description: Light trails on road at night
city_traffic_night.usage: Public Safety Campaign banner / Smart Traffic Systems initiative

highway_interchange.usage: Resource Center header background / Road Infrastructure Safety guide

police_patrol_car.usage: Emergency Hotlines section / Contact page visual accent

Live Threat / Traffic Alert Ticker Bar
Navigation Links: Home, Safety Quiz, Initiatives, News, Resources, Contact
Language Switcher (EN / AR) with RTL direction trigger
Urgent Announcement Banner (Animated ticker with road closure / weather alerts)
Kinetic Hero Headline: 'Precision Safety on Every Road'

Primary CTAs: 'Take Safety Knowledge Quiz' & 'Report Traffic Concern'

features: Immediate scored feedback with detailed legal/safety explanations
Badge / Certificate shareable card on 80%+ score

safety_programs.title: Active Department Initiatives & Campaigns
cards: Child Safety Seat Fitting & Verification Stations

news_and_announcements.title: Official Bulletins, Regulations & Statistics

grids_and_layouts.marketing_bento: Asymmetric 12-column grid layout for Hero & Safety Programs (col-span-12 md:col-span-8 and col-span-4)
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: Tight 4-column grid layout for Admin Enquiry Portal with stat cards and tabular records
grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16 (Generous spacing to convey civic weight and legibility)

motion_and_interactions.stagger_children: 0.08s stagger on program cards and quiz options
motion_and_interactions.quiz_animations: Smooth slide transitions between questions and celebratory scale pulse on complete score
motion_and_interactions.alert_ticker: Infinite horizontal marquee ticker for public announcements using CSS keyframe or motion div

accessibility_and_rtl.rtl_implementation: Dynamic document HTML dir attribute toggle ('ltr' or 'rtl') driven by language context
accessibility_and_rtl.arabic_fonts: Readex Pro for UI body, Amiri for featured quotes and titles
accessibility_and_rtl.touch_targets: Minimum 44px x 44px for all buttons and interactive quiz options
accessibility_and_rtl.test_id_policy: All interactive elements, input fields, quiz choices, and submit buttons MUST include data-testid attribute

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete React full-stack web app with FastAPI backend.
Ensure language switcher toggles seamlessly between English (LTR) and Arabic (RTL) with proper text translations for all sections.
Implement the Interactive Safety Quiz with multiple choice options, immediate feedback score, progress bar, and detailed legal explanation modal/card.
Ensure the contact form posts data to backend endpoint `/api/enquiries` and admin dashboard view `/admin` allows searching, filtering, and marking enquiries resolved.
Apply all fonts and styles specified in this guidelines document, using Cabinet Grotesk / Montserrat for EN headings, Readex Pro / Amiri for AR headings.
Include all testids specified in tests and follow data-testid naming conventions (`data-testid='...'`).
Verify that the header is sticky with glassmorphism blur (`backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/90 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 z-50`).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_slop_rule: Avoid generic Vercel/Inter dark mode slop. Use rich civic slate navy (#0F172A), signal ambers (#F59E0B), and crisp tactical borders to convey official government authority and public warmth.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility: Ensure full WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, high text contrast, accessible form labels, keyboard navigation for the quiz, and complete RTL layout support.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All buttons, inputs, tabs, quiz choices, language switches, and links MUST have data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
